extra.final_summary:
Units sold per region (sum of Quantity): North 40, South 53, East 28, West 62 (43 rows total).

Data issues found & fixed:
- Region had 6 label variants (case: "north", "east"; misspellings: "Nort", "Suoth", "Wst"). Merged them into the allowed labels North/South/East/West via normalize_labels (approved).
- Quantity column is clean (numeric, no negatives, min 1).

Caveats: The question only depends on Region and Quantity, both now clean. Other columns (e.g., Price stored as text like "$350.00", an invalid date "2026-14-01" on row 8) were not needed for this question and were left unchanged.
